text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's the evening, and Biwa Hayahide<n>and I have
just finished buying some<n>training supplies. We're
on our way<n>home, when...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hm? It looks like something's going<n>on over there...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with<n>our New Year's
raffle! This year's<n>grand prize is a hot spring
vacation<n>for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot<n>hamburger
steak! Second-prize<n>winners get a bushel of
carrots! And<n>third-prize winners can take home a
single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Don't let this opportunity pass you<n>by! Get a ticket
now and spin for your<n>chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
A raffle, huh? Didn't we get<n>something that looked
like a raffle<n>ticket from the store?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Since we have one, why don't you<n>give it a—
choice_data_list: Get out there and win a big one, Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You want me to go up there?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's not that! I just... hadn't<n>considered going
myself.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm usually the one watching things<n>unfold, not the
one participating in the<n>actual event...
choice_data_list: Did you always let Brian take the spotlight?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Well, yes... She was always so sweet<n>when she
won something.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Back when she was still quiet and<n>shy, the only
time she would get<n>excited and yell aloud was
when she<n>won something.
choice_data_list: Well, today, it's your turn to get excited.
Well, today, it's your turn to get excited.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Um... I'd hate to disappoint you, but I<n>don't think
that'll be happening...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide gathers her courage,<n>walks up to
the raffle spinner, and<n>gives the handle a crank.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A small plastic ball drops from the<n>tumbler's
opening...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves<n>a grand-prize
winner! Come and get<n>the coupon for your hot
spring<n>vacation! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I won the grand prize?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I-indeed...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I-I'm fine. I'm just still in shock...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The odds seem so impossible. There<n>must be 300
balls in the machine, and<n>of those, there can't be
many for the<n>grand prize—

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: That's right! There's only one ball forthe grand prize!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: We beat 300-to-1 odds on our first<n>try?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I-I guess...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But wow, a voucher for a hot spring<n>vacation... It'd
be nice to go once<n>things calm down.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I'm sorry! This is your prize too,<n>so of course
you're free to invite<n>whoever you'd like. I'm not
sure<n>why I assumed it would be me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What was I thinking? I guess I must<n>still be in
shock.
choice_data_list: I don't mind if you want to use it for yourself.
I don't mind if you want to use it for yourself.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What?! You're all right letting me<n>have it?! Hm...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
All right, how's this? After the<n>Twinkle Series is
over, we can give<n>more thought as to which one of
us<n>should use it and how.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And if we both happen to be free...<n>Well, we can
cross that bridge when<n>we get to it.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Biwa Hayahide puts<n>away the
voucher very carefully.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize<n>winner!
Congratulations! You get one<n>deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yay! I won something!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I can't believe I actually won—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ahem... Yes, well, now I can certainly<n>see how one
might get a little excited<n>about winning first prize.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We won this with that ticket we got at<n>the training
supply store, so...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I think it's only fair if we split it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Of course! But only if you promise not<n>to tell anyone
about my little outburst<n>here.
choice_data_list: Ah, so it's a bribe of sorts.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: N-no! Just... please don't let anyone<n>know.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If Brian were to find out I was acting<n>like a little kid
over some raffle... Ugh,<n>the whole thing would be far
too<n>embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I promise to take her secret to the<n>grave, and we
enjoy the hamburger<n>steak together.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's<n>your lucky day!
You're going home<n>with a bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Wow, this is... a lot of carrots. Well, I<n>guess I won't
need to buy any for a<n>while.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Since I have so many, I'd like to give<n>you some as
a small token of my<n>gratitude for all your hard work!
choice_data_list: And what about Ticket and Taishin over there?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You read my mind. I was planning to<n>share some
with them too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ticket! Taishin! Over here!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Thank youuu!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Look out, Trainer. Make sure<n>she doesn't
knock you over when<n>she comes flying over he—

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Crash!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh my gosh! Are you two okay?!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And that's how we end up sharing a<n>whole bushel
of carrots with Winning<n>Ticket and Narita Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won<n>the third prize!
Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yay!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ahem... Yes, well, winning third prize<n>is quite a feat.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We decide to split the prize, so we<n>each have half a
carrot.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you<n>pulled a blank one!
Take this pack of<n>tissues as a consolation prize.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What? I only get a pack of tissues?
choice_data_list: It just wasn't your lucky day.
It just wasn't your lucky day.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I... guess not. But I did learn<n>something.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Brian used to be crushed when she<n>didn't win. I
thought she was<n>adorable whenever she wilted like
that.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But now I understand how<n>disappointing it actually
feels not to<n>win anything.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I console Biwa Hayahide as we<n>resume our walk
back home...
